svg.title: Test feeds are served 7 to 10 days after the last train day: popularity inputs are 9 to 11 days old there, 1.75 days on the holdout

cc:Work.dc:title: Test feeds are served 7 to 10 days after the last train day: popularity inputs are 9 to 11 days old there, 1.75 days on the holdout
cc:Work.dc:description: Top: a calendar strip from 6 to 29 September 2026. Train covers 6 to 14 and 17 to 19 September, validation Tuesday 22 and Thursday 24, test 26 to 29; the public part of test ends on Sunday 27 at 11:32 and the rest is private. Bottom: four horizontal lines on the same day scale, 1.75 days for the holdout, 5.69 for validation, 9.34 for public and 11.23 for private; the last three all start around 17 September, inside the last train days.
